[SWS_DM_00017] Calculation of the FDC based on the internal de- bounce counter
⌈
The DM shall calculate the FDC based on the value and range of
the internal debounce counter by linear mapping.
⌋

[SWS_DM_00017] Calculation of the FDC based on the internal de- bounce counter
⌈
The DM shall calculate the FDC according to UDS, based on the
value and range of the internal debounce counter by linear mapping in order to achieve
a value range of -128 ... +127.
⌋
